selection: Units: a match seed (all its matches on every build and both first movers) and a case script (its cases on every build).
Scripts with a -human/-ai variant pair: one variant to discovery, the other to held-out (disjoint variants). Single-variant scripts go wholly to one partition.
Seeds: every non-empty proper subset of the frozen seeds goes to discovery, the rest to held-out (disjoint seeds).

Candidates are enumerated in an order fixed by the salt and scored lexicographically: (1) rules covered in both partitions, (2) the smaller of the two partition coverage counts, (3) closeness of the discovery share of observations (cases + matches) to discoveryTarget, (4) enumeration order.
Coverage: gaps.ts semantics over the frozen coverage map (every pattern of a rule on every build). Only engine-reported events are used; agent output is never an input.
notes: Seeds are the AI-vs-AI seeds of the P5 generation procedure p5-generation-1 (evidence/gw2/procedures/generation-p5-1.json), frozen at the same time; scripted cases use the fixed script seeds of gamewatch/scenarios.ts (97100) and gamewatch/gw2/scenarios-p5.ts (98100).

Frozen before any P5 observation was generated (generation-p5-1 run "experiment"). The selection rules are unchanged from p3-partition-1; matrix-* scripts have no -human/-ai variant, so each goes wholly to one partition and keeps both sides of an R7 comparison together.
